CustomField.description: Strength of the dark layer between the picture and the white text. Leave it blank (--None--) to show the picture exactly as it is; white text can then be hard to read on light or busy pictures. Light, Medium and Strong darken it progressively. New widgets start on Medium.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Darkens the picture behind the text. --None-- shows the picture as it is, but white text can be hard to read on light pictures. Use Strong for light or busy photos.
CustomField.label: Hero Overlay
